purpose: Turn evidence-based self-management into repeatable real-world decision training; never substitute stories or motivational claims for evidence.
frozen_business_source: User-owned V10 frozen corpus/workbook requirements; source document bytes remain outside this public repository.
five_why: Reading alone is insufficient because the frozen goal is behavior and decision change, not page count.
Pre-registered predictions separate real judgment quality from hindsight explanation.
Reversal makes important conclusions falsifiable by counterevidence.
Stop-loss and reversible actions bound downside while learning from real decisions.
30/90-day effectiveness cannot be pre-declared because it requires observed longitudinal data.

risk_boundary.rule: High-risk cases must escalate to qualified/current authority or professional verification; stories and model output never replace it.
risk_boundary.personal_effectiveness: No growth/effectiveness claim before 30/90-day observable evidence.

frozen_method: 5 Why layers are hypotheses, not causal proof
